shapes.name: subtitle
shapes.text: 30 minutes to propose a next test

shapes.name: body
shapes.text: Two activities connect an observation to a testable response. The service owner decides what to approve afterward.

shapes.name: guide
shapes.text: Start with the evidence. Return here whenever you need another activity.

shapes.name: intro
shapes.text: These invented records are the whole evidence set for this exercise. They do not establish prevalence or a product outcome.

shapes.name: b1
shapes.text: One participant opened the events calendar before finding the room-booking route.

shapes.name: b2
shapes.text: A different participant asked whether the final acknowledgement meant the booking was complete.

shapes.name: b3
shapes.text: No production analytics, retest or engineering estimate is available.

shapes.name: intro
shapes.text: Choose E01 or E02. Write what the record supports, then a possible explanation. Keep the two separate.

shapes.name: steps
shapes.text: 2 min alone: write one statement per area. 5 min together: compare interpretations. 3 min: record a counterexample to look for.

shapes.name: output
shapes.text: Output F01: a provisional finding with its evidence ID and one uncertainty. Passing is welcome; written input counts.

shapes.name: intro
shapes.text: Use F01 to propose a small change or a further research step. Name what a retest would need to show.

shapes.name: steps
shapes.text: 3 min alone: propose a response. 4 min together: challenge the assumption. 3 min: write a check and proposed owner.

shapes.name: output
shapes.text: Record disagreement beside D01. Keep the owner unassigned until someone accepts it. A proposal is awaiting review.

shapes.name: intro
shapes.text: The facilitator reads the record aloud or shares it in writing. The service owner reviews it after the workshop; no approval is implied.

shapes.name: b1
shapes.text: D01: [response] Based on F01 and [E01 or E02]

shapes.name: b2
shapes.text: [Concern, alternative or no contribution] Silence is not agreement.

shapes.name: b3
shapes.text: [Accepted owner or unassigned] [Review date or not scheduled]

shapes.name: closing
shapes.text: Outcomes remain unmeasured. Record an approval only with the decision maker’s name and actual decision.

shapes.name: eyebrow
shapes.text: ASYNC ROUTE / NO EXTRA LIVE TIME

shapes.name: intro
shapes.text: Use the evidence page and the two activity areas independently. A spoken contribution is optional.

shapes.name: step1
shapes.text: 1 Write F01 with an evidence ID, an interpretation and a competing explanation.

shapes.name: step2
shapes.text: 2 Draft D01 and an observable retest criterion. Add any concern or alternative.

shapes.name: step3
shapes.text: 3 Give the record to the facilitator using the agreed channel. The owner considers it with the live notes.

shapes.name: closing
shapes.text: Before a real session, name the facilitator, submission channel and deadline. All are unassigned in this fictional example.
